question: Swapnil goes to the park every day for walking. One morning, he started walking from his home and walked 40 km towards North. Then, he turned to the right and walked 60 km. Again, he turned right and walked 40 km. Lastly, he took a left turn and walked 30 km. In which direction is he now from his home?
solution:
Given: 

One morning, Swapnil started walking from his home and walked 40 km towards North.

Then, he turned to the right and walked 60 km.

Again, he turned right and walked 40 km.

Lastly, he took a left turn and walked 30 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27dc2d17a5640f693291bcb6ac20ea43b445755367c4cf85b249c8b624959e20.png] 

So, Swapnil is at the '**East**' direction is he now from his home.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
